slides.title: What is a Map? 🗺️
slides.text: A map is a flat, two-dimensional representation of the Earth or a part of it, drawn on paper. It has length and breadth but no depth, helping us view continents, countries, rivers, and cities all at once!
slides.spoken: A map is a flat, two-dimensional representation of the Earth or a part of it, drawn on paper. It helps us view continents, countries, rivers, and cities all at once!

slides.title: Types of Maps 🎨
slides.text: There are three main types of maps! Physical maps show natural features like mountains in brown and rivers in blue. Political maps show human-made borders of states and countries. Thematic maps show one specific topic like rainfall or population.
slides.spoken: There are three main types of maps! Physical maps show natural features like mountains in brown and rivers in blue. Political maps show state borders. Thematic maps show specific topics like rainfall.

slides.title: Six Key Elements of a Map 🧭
slides.text: Every good map must have six key elements: a Title (what it shows), a Direction indicator (north arrow), a Scale (map distance vs real distance), Symbols (conventional signs), a Legend or key, and standard Colours!
slides.spoken: Every good map must have six key elements: a title, a direction indicator, a scale, symbols, a legend, and standard colours!

slides.title: Globe vs Map & Atlas 📖
slides.text: A globe is a three-dimensional ball model showing the whole Earth. A map is flat, portable, and shows small areas in great detail. Many maps bound together in a book form an atlas with an index to locate places quickly!
slides.spoken: A globe is a three dimensional ball model. A map is flat and portable. An atlas is a collection of maps bound together in a book!

slides.title: Physical Divisions of India 🏔️
slides.text: India is divided into six main physical divisions: Northern Mountains (snow-capped Himalayas), Northern Plains (flat and fertile alluvium), Peninsular Plateau (oldest Deccan landmass), Coastal Plains, Thar Desert, and Islands!
slides.spoken: India is divided into six physical divisions: Northern Mountains, Northern Plains, Peninsular Plateau, Coastal Plains, Thar Desert, and Islands!

They are exactly the same thing in different colours
